text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: O Great Miracle, you've gotta help me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down the
hallway, I spot
Daitaku Helios begging
K.S.Miracle for help.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're roomies with Rubae, right? If
anyone has
the deets on her, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What makes her happy?! What should I
do to
make her laugh?!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't you know that better than me?
You're
great at putting smiles on
people's faces.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It just doesn't seem to work on Rubae.
Like, I'm
starting to think I'm never
gonna get through to
her!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't party or do karaoke. Jokes
don't land
with her, and pranks are like,
don't even think
about it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But I just can't stop trying! I just...
Ugh, I
wanna
see her smile so baaad!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I see.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I'm sure your feelings are
getting across. As long as you continue
to be yourself, she'll
eventually open up
to you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Bet?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! Helios's Hype
Heaven
Round Two: Make Rubae Smile
Edition!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I tried my best...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nothing worked! Rubae's facial
expression is
harder to budge than
Jordan's nail extensions!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Helios! I know I'm, like, totally

overstepping here, buuut...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we team up again? Maybe
things will
be different with the two of
us working together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmster! I knew I could count on you,
bestie!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...But,
nah. I think I wanna do this myself!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I dunno know to explain it, but I wanna be the one to make her smile, y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I think I do. Gah,
I shouldn't have
tried to
butt in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, before I go, let me give you some
advice.
You should think hard about who
Ruby is, one
more time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I know you pay a lot of attention to her.
You probably haven't realized it yet
since you're scrambling around so much,
but you already know what you have to
do.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa, now that you mention it, there was this one time I saw her smiling...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I visit the park one day and come across a really bizarre... Well, I suppose it's more accurate to say a really fluffy sight.

text_block_list.name: One Hundred Dogs
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Why are there so many dogs here?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Rubae, you have a dog at home, yeah?
You
sounded so sweet when you were
talking about
your furry friend!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So I asked my buds for a favor and...
look! Six, seven... one hundred party
dogs for you to play with! Is this wild or
what? Like, totally
smile-worthy, no?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Is that all you wanted to talk about? If
so, I would
like to excuse myself.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What? Not even literal puppy dog eyes
will get
you?! Waaah! C'mon, smile for
me, Rubae!

text_block_list.name: One Hundred Dogs
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as Daitaku Helios starts crying,
all one
hundred dogs pounce on her!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hwagh! Omigosh! Holy fluff! Mmmf!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...!
...D-did you just laugh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa... You looked like an angel...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Is that all? Then I'll be taking my
leave.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Dang, she got me good...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Go ahead and play with them to your
heart's
content.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you looked at them just now, didn't
you?! I
knew you liked dogs! Aren't they
just paw-some?!
